summary: Iteration 2 (LIVE zero-cost OSM discovery + verified-facts research). Backend: 32/32 pytest passed (100%). Live OSM confirmed working end-to-end: POST /api/leads/find (Restaurant/Gurugram) returns 20 REAL OpenStreetMap POIs in ~250ms with provider.active='openstreetmap', live=true, fallback=false, is_demo=false, real openstreetmap.org/way/xxx source_urls, real phone numbers where OSM has them, null (never fabricated) where it doesn't. Clinic/Delhi returns 5 live POIs. Obscure Unicorn Rescue/MiddleOfNowhereXYZ correctly triggers fallback (provider.active='mock', fallback=true, all is_demo=true). Web research on Blue Tokai (live-found lead with website) captured real verified_facts.website: site_loaded=true, http_status=200, real title 'Buy Freshly Roasted Coffee Beans | Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters', has_contact_form=true, tech_hints.shopify=true, 3 real socials (twitter/facebook/instagram). Sources[] contains 5 REAL URLs only. generated_by='claude-sonnet-4-6'. ddgs search_results empty (rate-limited, graceful — acceptable per brief). Frontend: /finder shows GREEN 'Live results from OpenStreetMap' banner, NO DEMO badge on cards, 'No website'/'Phone: Not found' honestly displayed, 'Source: OpenStreetMap' link on each card. /leads/{id} shows blue 'VERIFIED FACTS (fetched from public web)' panel visually + textually separated from violet 'AI ASSESSMENT (generated)' panel, warning states AI content must be verified, contact panel shows 'Not found' for missing fields, 'Sources & Evidence' sidebar lists all real links. /settings integrations render correctly (OSM/web_research/web_search/AI Engine all LIVE, Google Places/Email/WhatsApp NOT CONNECTED). Regression: login, dashboard KPIs (53 leads, 22 new, 7 qualified etc.), all 11 pipeline stages, campaigns/clients/projects/tasks pages all HTTP 200. CSV export GET /api/export/leads-csv → 200 with 52 rows. ONE COPY BUG FOUND on Settings page top blurb (see below).

ui_bugs.issue: Line 36 of /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx still reads 'Lead Finder currently uses a <mock provider>' in amber. This is stale copy from iteration 1 and is factually wrong now that Lead Finder is LIVE via OpenStreetMap. It contradicts the LIVE badge on the OpenStreetMap Discovery card just below and undermines user trust in the zero-cost data. Replace with wording like 'Lead Finder currently runs on live OpenStreetMap data (zero cost, no API key). It falls back to clearly-labeled DEMO data only if the open web is unavailable.'

action_items: Update Settings.jsx line 36: replace 'mock provider' copy with an accurate description of the LIVE OpenStreetMap discovery. Everything else this iteration is working; no other main-agent action required.
critical_code_review_comments: providers.py OSMLeadProvider: clean, respectful of Nominatim (custom UA, jsonv2, addressdetails=1, extratags=1). Consider caching identical queries for a few minutes to reduce Nominatim load in demos, but not required.
web_research.py fetch_website_signals has a proper SSRF guard (_is_public_host resolves DNS and refuses private/loopback/link_local/reserved IPs) — good.
web_research.py ddgs import is inside _ddg_sync so the whole app doesn't hard-fail if the package changes; degrades to []. Good.

server.py POST /api/leads/{id}/research: builds sources ONLY from actually observed URLs; excellent zero-fabrication guarantee. verified_facts is stored on the research doc so the UI can render evidence separately from AI output.
Settings.jsx line 36: stale 'mock provider' copy — see UI bug above.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — cosmetic warning only.

server.py POST /api/leads/{lead_id}/research does NOT have a timeout budget; a slow prospect website could tie up a worker for up to 12s (already limited by httpx.Timeout in web_research.py — acceptable).

DuckDuckGo web search (ddgs) — unverified: upstream-empty — evidence: search_results returned [] on Blue Tokai research call (rate-limited or blocked from preview egress). No 'heuristic-fallback' seen.
